description:
About Bask Health
 Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.
 Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.
 We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.
 We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.
 About the Role
 We're looking for a Solutions Engineer, AI & Integrations to help prospective customers understand how Bask Health's technology can support their business requirements, technical integrations, and potential AI-enabled workflows.
 You'll work closely with Account Executives, Product, and Engineering throughout the sales process, leading technical discovery, delivering product demonstrations, and developing proposed solutions for customers with complex technical needs.
 Bask brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools. You'll help prospective merchants understand how these components work together and evaluate opportunities to connect Bask with their existing technology.
 You'll also help customers explore relevant AI and automation use cases, working with internal teams to distinguish supported capabilities from ideas that require additional evaluation.
 This is a customer-facing technical presales role for someone who enjoys working with APIs, software integrations, emerging technology, and complex business workflows.
 We're looking for someone who can understand customer requirements, explain technical concepts clearly, and develop practical solutions without overpromising platform capabilities.
 What You'll Do
 Partner with Account Executives throughout technical sales opportunities.
 Lead technical discovery with prospective customers.
 Understand customer business models, existing systems, and integration requirements.
 Identify opportunities for Bask's platform to support customer workflows.
 Translate technical and business requirements into proposed solutions.
 Deliver tailored product demonstrations for prospective merchants.
 Explain Bask's storefront, patient experience, checkout, and operational capabilities.
 Lead technical discussions involving APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
 Evaluate how customer systems could connect with Bask's platform.
 Identify technical dependencies, integration constraints, and potential risks.
 Develop proposed integration approaches based on supported platform functionality.
 Collaborate with Engineering to evaluate complex technical requirements.
 Work with Product to clarify available capabilities and product limitations.
 Help prospective customers explore potential AI-enabled workflows.
 Identify business processes where automation may be valuable.
 Evaluate proposed AI use cases against available platform functionality.
 Explain AI-related technical concepts to business and technical stakeholders.
 Help customers understand the differences between existing functionality and potential future capabilities.
 Support technical proof-of-value activities during customer evaluations.
 Develop technical diagrams illustrating proposed integrations and data flows.
 Prepare technical presentations and supporting documentation.
 Explain integration requirements to customer developers and engineering teams.
 Support discussions involving authentication, authorization, and data exchange.
 Identify relevant security, privacy, and data-handling considerations.
 Evaluate requirements involving storefronts, checkout, and patient-facing workflows.
 Help prospective merchants understand how automation could support operational processes.
 Coordinate internal technical reviews for complex customer requirements.
 Support technical responses to customer questionnaires and requests for information.
 Collaborate with Sales on technical portions of customer proposals.
 Document customer requirements, technical assumptions, and proposed solutions.
 Help identify implementation considerations before commercial agreements are finalized.
 Support the development of reusable technical demonstration materials.
 Create clear explanations of integration capabilities for prospective customers.
 Share recurring customer integration requirements with Product and Engineering.
 Provide feedback on customer interest in AI-enabled functionality.
 Help improve technical discovery and demonstration processes.
 Stay informed about relevant AI technologies, integration patterns, and platform developments.
 Support internal sales teams with technical questions and product explanations.
 Prepare technical handoff documentation for onboarding and implementation teams.
 Participate in technical handoff discussions after deals close.
 Take ownership of assigned technical evaluations and customer follow-ups.
 Ensure proposed solutions accurately reflect supported capabilities and realistic technical assumptions.
 This is a technical presales role . Production integration development, AI feature engineering, and ongoing post-sale implementation remain with the appropriate Product and Engineering teams.
 
 Requirements 
 
 3+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Presales, Solutions Consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role.
 Experience supporting technical evaluations for B2B SaaS or technology platforms.
 Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
 Experience conducting technical discovery with prospective customers.
 Ability to translate customer business requirements into practical technical solutions.
 Experience delivering technical product demonstrations.
 Understanding of modern web applications and SaaS architectures.
 Familiarity with AI technologies, AI-enabled software features, or workflow automation.
 Ability to evaluate proposed AI use cases and communicate technical limitations.
 Experience working with developers or engineering teams on integration requirements.
 Strong technical problem-solving and analytical skills.
 Ability to explain complex technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders.
 Experience developing technical documentation, diagrams, or solution proposals.
 Understanding of authentication, authorization, and data exchange concepts.
 Ability to identify integration risks and technical dependencies.
 Experience collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams.
 Strong presentation and customer communication skills.
 Experience managing multiple technical evaluations simultaneously.
 Ability to document customer requirements accurately.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
 Ability to learn new software platforms and technical capabilities quickly.
 Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
 Nice to Have
 Experience with AI-powered SaaS products.
 Familiarity with large language models and AI application integrations.
 Experience working with OpenAI APIs or similar AI services.
 Understanding of prompt engineering and AI workflow design.
 Experience with retrieval-augmented generation or AI agent workflows.
 Working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or another programming language.
 Experience using Postman or similar API testing tools.
 Familiarity with workflow automation tools.
 Experience supporting technical proof-of-concept or proof-of-value activities.
 Understanding of e-commerce or merchant technology platforms.
 Familiarity with Shopify or online storefront integrations.
 Experience working with telehealth or healthcare technology.
 Understanding of patient experience or clinical workflow systems.
 Familiarity with healthcare data privacy and security considerations.
 Experience with Stripe or payment-related integrations.
 Experience supporting complex enterprise technical evaluations.
 Familiarity with white-label SaaS platforms.
 Experience working at a growing technology company.
